verdict.rationale: Aircall is a SaaS platform with a public developer portal, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions llms.txt or any docs designed for agents. Its only machine-readable surface is a Postman collection, and it states that no OpenAPI spec is published, so neither counts as agent-oriented documentation for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
